jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
**What Cloud Engineering contributes to Cardinal Health**

Information Technology oversees the effective development, delivery, and operation of computing and information services. This function anticipates, plans, and delivers Information Technology solutions and strategies that enable operations and drive business value.

Cloud Engineering analyzes the financial, operational, and technical feasibility of adopting external cloud-based IT software, platform, and infrastructure services. This job family evaluates the costs and benefits of cloud, virtual private networks, dedicated housing, and in-house solutions and identifies portions of the organization’s IT infrastructure with the highest potential return for cloud deployment. Cloud Engineering also manages the implementation of cloud services and their integration with in-house applications and systems, coordinating with vendors and adhering to engineering best practices.

**Qualifications**

* BA, BS or equivalent experience in related field. Advance Degree may be required
* 4-8 years experience
* Understands high-level to area-specific concepts and architecture of Cloud platforms. Knowledgeable on permission levels and how it provides accesses to individuals
* Able to analyze and recommend on resource allocation based on capacity management and analysis on Cloud platforms
* Active participation on the projects, designing the technical solution and oversee the deployment process to align the implementation with the architecture proposed.
* Create intermediate to advance scripting (Shell/Python/Powershell) methods to enhance or automate certain tasks, within OS and outside platforms (GCP, AWS)
* Able to propose enhancements and new set of tools, upgrades, and automations as tools for the environment on process-specific to general-process level
* Knows the intermediate concept of networking, firewall rulings and ports and how it impacts OS / platform performance
* Able to create Change control activities based off on the overall infrastructure availability and present to CCB
* Able to perform root cause analysis (RCA) and recommends permanent corrective actions based on the analysis
* Ability to create data-driven reports and analysis using tools provided within CAH and to provide next action items for leaning existing processes and resolving issues
* Strong knowledge of GCP and AWS architecture (SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS)
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure maintenance and delivery within an enterprise environment.
* Able to evaluate (architecture, cost, technology) for Cloud and hybrid environments.
* Strong knowledge or concept on how the NFS and SMB
* Strong knowledge of Cloud Storage, Kubernetes and S3 Bucket (Security/Policies)

**What is expected of you and others at this level**

* Applies comprehensive knowledge and a thorough understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to perform varied tasks and projects
* May contribute to the development of policies and procedures
* Works on complex projects of large scope
* Develops technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems. Solutions are innovative and consistent with organization objectives
* Completes work independently receives general guidance on new projects
* Work reviewed for purpose of meeting objectives
* May act as a mentor to less experienced colleagues

Cardinal Health supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate the power of our differences to create better solutions for our customers by ensuring employees can be their authentic selves each day. Cardinal Health is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Philippines – Remote | Full-time

PHP 100,000 - 116,666/month

**The role**

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team and help build, automate, and maintain cloud infrastructure that powers Tribal’s global education software.

You’ll work as part of a globally distributed team, owning cloud infrastructure across Azure (primary), AWS, and Oracle Cloud. The focus is engineering, not just support — building and maintaining scalable, well-architected environments, driving automation, and reducing manual overhead. You’ll collaborate directly with internal teams and contribute to platform improvements that directly affect system availability and reliability.

This role is suited to someone who is cloud-native in their thinking, comfortable working autonomously across time zones, and always looking for a better, more automated way to do things.

**Key responsibilities**

**Cloud Infrastructure & Engineering**

* Assist in design, build and maintain cloud infrastructure across Azure (primary) Cloud environments, knowledge of AWS useful
* Deploy and manage Kubernetes clusters, ensuring reliable, scalable containerised workloads
* Be familiar with traditional Azure compute stack and services
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery across platform environments
* Work with FluxCD and GitOps practices to manage infrastructure state and deployments
* Migrate infrastructure to modern cloud-native practices, reducing reliance on legacy compute
* Ensure infrastructure adheres to Well-Architected Framework principles across all environments
* Familiar with AI tooling, Claude Co-Pilot etc

**Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and native cloud tooling
* Identify and implement automation to remove manual, repetitive operational tasks
* Write and maintain automation scripts using Bash, Python, or equivalent scripting languages
* Contribute to tooling and platform improvements that increase reliability and reduce toil

**Reliability & Security**

* Maintain and improve observability across the platform estate — monitoring, alerting, and automated recovery
* Ensure all infrastructure is kept up to date with security patches and best practice standards
* Work with the security team to maintain a security-first mindset across all environments
* Support and resolve platform incidents where required, working within defined SLAs
* Participate in out-of-hours on-call rota as required

**What we’re looking for**

**Essential**

* Computer Science degree (or comparable qualification / equivalent experience)
* 3–5+ years commercial experience working with cloud environments (Azure essential, AWS or Oracle a plus)
* Experience with containerization and orchestration — Kubernetes preferred
* Experience with Azure services such as AKS, Azure DevOps, or similar
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred)
* Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in a DevOps environment
* Experience working as part of a global, distributed team
* Proficiency in scripting languages — Bash, Python, or similar
* Good understanding of Linux, networking, and web servers (Apache, Nginx)
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail with the ability to plan and prioritise independently

**Desirable**

* Experience with FluxCD or other GitOps tooling — the team uses FluxCD, so this is a real plus
* Familiarity with serverless and microservice architectures
* Cloud provider certification (Azure, AWS, or Oracle)
* Understanding of service desk processes and SLA management
* Experience with complex third-party integrations (SSO, APIs)

  

**What can Tribal offer you?**

We offer a range of exceptional benefits to support your wellbeing and work-life balance, including a comprehensive HMO and Employee Assistance Programme, a competitive parental leave package, and the ability to buy or sell holiday each year.

You’ll also have access to:

* E-Learning Opportunities to grow your skills
* Volunteer Days to give back to the community
* Regular employee engagement activities
* Achievers – our reward and recognition platform
* Competitive retirement plan

We’re committed to creating a flexible and supportive workplace that lets you balance life inside and outside of work. If you need flexibility, apply and let’s talk.

***As an equal opportunity employer, Tribal celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We make sure that our recruitment and selection processes never discriminate based upon any protected characteristics and actively welcome applications from all groups, not least those underrepresented in the tech sector.***

**Note to all applicants -** *Tribal reserve the right to close an advertisement to applications ahead of the advertised closure date. For this reason, shortlisting may take place prior to the closing date on some occasions. With this in mind, please do not hesitate to apply early.*

**AI IN RECRUITMENT AND SELECTION**

We understand many people use AI tools to help with their applications and we’re comfortable with that when used responsibly. What matters to us is honesty. Please don’t use AI to misrepresent your skills or experience, as it affects fairness and may lead us to withdraw your application. We value authenticity and want to get to know the real you. Please note that all of our formal interviews will be carried out with a strict ‘camera on’ policy and you will be asked to verify your identity as part of the formal interview process.

### **Network Engineer I**

* JR-164895
* Hybrid

* Manila

* Full time

**Who are we?**

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

**Job Summary**

Equinix Customer Support Team is seeking a **Network Engineer I** to join our global customer-facing team. This is a technical customer support role, where you will serve as a trusted technical support specialist, helping customers, including those requiring application and product support as well as network specialists, achieve success on our platform and be their trusted support partner in case of service impacting events. You will provide hands-on troubleshooting, guidance, and technical expertise to ensure seamless resolution and an exceptional customer experience for Equinix’ interconnection portfolio.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Support customers and internal stakeholders to troubleshoot and optimize solutions built on Equinix Interconnection Services
* Leverage your expertise in networking, cloud technologies, and application support to deliver exceptional technical outcomes
* Engage across multiple channels—live chat, Slack, Teams, and Salesforce (SFDC) ticketing system—to provide timely and effective support
  

Customer Support & Engagement

* Manage and resolve technical support cases via Salesforce, Slack, Teams, and other platforms
* Work in a priority-based ticket environment, recognizing high impactful events and address with appropriate urgency
* Perform ticket technical troubleshooting, collaboration with Engineering and Network teams and resolution with a focus on quality and speed
* Maintain proactive communication with customers and internal stakeholders throughout the support lifecycle
  

Technical Expertise

* Develop deep knowledge of Equinix Interconnection Services, including APIs, Portals and other mission critical systems
* Assist with incident management protocols and act as a communication lead during customer-impacting events
* Provide technical insights to sales, product, and operations teams to improve customer experience
  

Knowledge Sharing & Documentation

* Contribute to public-facing documentation and internal SOPs
* Create and maintain training materials for team onboarding and continuous learning
* Promote self-service by improving knowledge base content
  

**Qualifications**

Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in technical support or customer engineering roles, preferably in networking or cloud environments
  

Technical Skills

* Strong knowledge of Networking (OSI Layers 1–3); CCNA or similar certification is a plus
* Proficient in Optical Networking technologies and principles; DWDM, Metro Ethernet / MLAN is a plus
* Strong expertise in Layer 1 troubleshooting, including fibre optics, signal integrity, and physical connectivity diagnostics
* Comprehensive understanding of Internet Exchange (IX) peering principles, routing policies, and traffic optimization strategies
* Comprehensive understanding of Internet architecture, including protocols (BGP, TCP/IP), DNS, and global routing mechanisms
* Familiarity with Network Service Providers (NSP) and Cloud Service Provider (CSP) environment
* Familiarity with fabric cloud technology and platforms (Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure)
* Familiarity with OpenStack (IaaS), Network Function Virtualization (NFV) is a plus
* API and application integration experience is a plus
* Understanding of incident management and troubleshooting methodologies
  

Soft Skills

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong problem-solving mindset and customer-first attitude
* Ability to lead and mentor peers in technical and operational best practices
* Desire to self-educate and learn technical concepts and product knowledge
  

Other Requirements

* Willingness to work rotational shifts, including night shifts aligned with AMER business hours, weekends, and holidays
* Strong team player with a collaborative mindset
  

Critical Success Factors

* Passion for technology and solving complex customer challenges
* Ability to work collaboratively across global teams
* Commitment to continuous learning and knowledge sharing
* Embody Equinix values: Integrity – Act with honesty and transparency Customer Focus – Put customers at the center of everything you do Sustainability – Drive efficiency and long-term solutions Teamwork – Collaborate across teams and geographies to achieve shared goals

jobs.title: IT HARDWARE AND INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER
jobs.description:
**JOB OVERVIEW**

We are looking for an IT Hardware and Infrastructure Engineer to manage, install, maintain, and troubleshoot the company's IT hardware, computer systems, network infrastructure, and electronic security systems.

The role focuses on ensuring the reliability and efficient operation of computers, servers, network devices, CCTV systems, access control systems, and other IT infrastructure supporting company operations.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktop computers, laptops, printers, workstations, and other IT equipment.
* Assist in developing and improving the company's IT infrastructure, including servers, network equipment, and communication systems.
* Configure and maintain routers, switches, wireless access points, structured cabling, and other network devices.
* Assist in managing physical and virtual servers, storage devices, and backup systems.
* Install, configure, and maintain CCTV cameras, recording devices, and surveillance systems.
* Maintain and troubleshoot biometric attendance devices, electronic access control, and other security hardware.
* Perform hardware inspections, diagnostics, repairs, component replacements, and preventive maintenance.
* Handle IT equipment installation, relocation, configuration, and commissioning across company facilities.
* Ensure proper connectivity among computers, servers, printers, CCTV systems, and other network-connected devices.
* Monitor IT hardware inventory, equipment assignments, serial numbers, warranties, and maintenance records.
* Prepare network diagrams, hardware configuration records, maintenance logs, and infrastructure documentation.
* Implement preventive maintenance schedules to minimize equipment failures and system downtime.
* Provide technical support for advanced hardware and infrastructure issues and coordinate with external service providers when necessary.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by the Head of IT Department.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or any related technical field.
* Knowledge of computer hardware, networking, server systems, and IT infrastructure.
* Relevant certifications in computer hardware servicing, networking, server administration, or IT infrastructure are an advantage.
* Technical-vocational graduates with relevant experience may also be considered.

**EXPERIENCE & TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**

* With relevant work experience in IT hardware support, computer engineering, network administration, or IT infrastructure management.
* Fresh graduates with demonstrated hardware installation, networking, and troubleshooting skills may be considered.
* Experience in computer assembly, hardware diagnostics, and component replacement is preferred.
* Familiarity with routers, switches, structured cabling, and wireless networking systems is an advantage.
* Experience in CCTV installation, configuration, and maintenance is preferred.
* Exposure to server administration, virtualization, network storage, and backup systems is an advantage.
* Experience with biometric attendance systems and electronic access control devices is preferred.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Interested applicants may send their updated CV/resume to our recruitment team.

Join our IT team and help strengthen our company's technology infrastructure and digital capabilities!

Pay: Php16,000.00 - Php22,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
